newsitem.title: USA: Lehigh seeks 1:30 reverse split, new listing.
newsitem.headline: Lehigh seeks 1:30 reverse split, new listing.

text.p: The Lehigh Group Inc said Wednesday it is planning a 1:30 reverse stock split and that it has been cleared by the American Stock Exchange to apply to have its shares listed on that exchange.

The New York Stock Exchange said last month it would delist the company's shares July 10, but Lehigh said Wednesday the NYSE has agreed to extend the date to give it time to arrange for an orderly transition to another market place.
Lehigh said it expects the reverse split to happen in mid- to late-August, pending clearance of proxy materials by the Securities and Exchange Commission and stockholder action.
Additionally, the company said, it will seek the conversion of all preferred shares into common shares.
The company said its subsidiary has merged with First Medical Corp, and that it will change its name from Lehigh Group Inc to First Medical Group Inc.
